description: Optional server-side (or async) data provider for TmTimeline, TmActivityTimeline, and TmActivityLog. Implement this to power filtering and incremental ("load more") pagination of audit-scale timelines from an API or database. When no provider is supplied the components fall back to filtering and paging the in-memory Entries list client-side, so existing consumers keep working unchanged. For a ready-made in-memory implementation, use InMemoryTimelineDataProvider from Tempo.Blazor.

members.name: GetEntriesAsync
members.description: Fetches a filtered, windowed slice of timeline entries for the given query.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Filter and paging options for the requested slice.

parameters.name: ct
parameters.description: Token used to cancel the operation.
